title: Factual gate scored 0.5 on 2019 Serie A standings, but the code returns the correct record
evidence: _factual.json: 'got row figures [6,49,37,86,4,38,90,1,28]' — these decode to 28W-6D-4L, 38 played, 90 pts, which IS the expected answer; integration_test.go:76 asserts standings.Standings[0].Points==90 and champion==flamengo and passes. The gate's naive field-order match produced a false negative rather than the code producing doubled figures.
suggestion: No code change needed; the analyticalMatches dedup (query.go:88 primary-complete-season shortcut) already yields the correct 380-match 2019 table. The factual checker's extraction, not the server, is the source of the 0.5.

title: Very dense single-line construction limits readability
evidence: maintainability=0.476 (scores.json); load.go:200 builds Player with ~13 fields on one line, server.go registers all 8 tools as one-line closures. Functional but hard to diff/review.
suggestion: Optional: break the widest struct literals and tool registrations across lines. No behavioral impact.
